description: §6.7.1a — a markup-as-value assignment inside an `on mount { }` body lowers through the real statement codegen. `@label = <span id="mv">hi</>` — pre-fix this hit E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC (the string rewriter re-emitted the markup as source text `< span > hi < / >`, invalid JS). Post-fix the markup lowers to a real DOM node built by document.createElement, and the following `@ran = true` also runs. No input — the boot/mount shape.
rationale: §6.7.1a sugar-equivalence — markup-as-value (Pillar 1 §1.4/§7.4) inside `on mount` lowers exactly as inside a `function` body: the `<span>` expression becomes a constructed DOM node assigned to @label, and subsequent statements execute (@ran = true).
